stage1_hook.title: Hook & Win State
stage1_hook.physical_cue: Hold up: 1 Brass Lantern token & 1 Charter Card
stage1_hook.pitch_aloud: You are rival harbor wardens guiding cargo sloops through shifting coastal fog. Light stone beacons along dangerous channels, haul Spice, Glass, and Timber to the wharves, and fulfill shipping Charters before winter closes the bay.
stage1_hook.win_summary: The captain with the most Prestige (★) from fulfilled Charters, lit Beacon rings, and leftover Harbor Seals wins.

win_trigger_by_players.2: Trigger end-game when any captain reaches 6 completed Charters, OR when the Fog Bell Deck runs out (finish equal turns).
win_trigger_by_players.3: Trigger end-game when any captain reaches 5 completed Charters, OR when the Fog Bell Deck runs out (finish equal turns).
win_trigger_by_players.4: Trigger end-game when any captain reaches 5 completed Charters, OR when the Fog Bell Deck runs out (finish equal turns).
win_trigger_by_players.5: Trigger end-game when any captain reaches 4 completed Charters, OR when the Fog Bell Deck runs out (finish equal turns).

deltas.2: Calm Bay side face up; cover 4 outer reef piers with Fog Caps.
deltas.3: Calm Bay side face up; cover 2 outer reef piers with Fog Caps.
deltas.4: Open Bay side face up; leave all outer piers open (0 blocked).
deltas.5: Open Bay side face up; attach the Auxiliary Pier board edge tile.

deltas.2: Deal 14 cards face down; place Winter Gale strictly on the bottom.
deltas.3: Deal 16 cards face down; place Winter Gale strictly on the bottom.
deltas.4: Deal 18 cards face down; place Winter Gale strictly on the bottom.
deltas.5: Deal 20 cards face down; place Winter Gale strictly on the bottom.

deltas.2: Reveal 4 Charter Cards face up along the Wharf strip.
deltas.3: Reveal 5 Charter Cards face up along the Wharf strip.
deltas.4: Reveal 5 Charter Cards face up along the Wharf strip.
deltas.5: Reveal 6 Charter Cards face up along the Wharf strip.

deltas.2: Stock 6 crates each of Spice, Glass, and Timber in the Warehouse.
deltas.3: Stock 8 crates each of Spice, Glass, and Timber in the Warehouse.
deltas.4: Stock 10 crates each of Spice, Glass, and Timber in the Warehouse.
deltas.5: Stock 12 crates each of Spice, Glass, and Timber in the Warehouse.

shared_board.name: Lighthouse Track & Central Buoy
shared_board.static_text: All player counts: Place the Lighthouse Track marker on 1 and set the wooden Fog Bank Buoy on Central Channel.

deltas.2: Each player takes 1 Warden Mat, 1 Sloop, and 10 Lanterns.
deltas.3: Each player takes 1 Warden Mat, 1 Sloop, and 9 Lanterns.
deltas.4: Each player takes 1 Warden Mat, 1 Sloop, and 8 Lanterns.
deltas.5: Each player takes 1 Warden Mat, 1 Sloop, and 7 Lanterns.

deltas.2: Deal 4 Charter Cards to each player; keep 2 and discard 2.
deltas.3: Deal 3 Charter Cards to each player; keep 2 and discard 1.
deltas.4: Deal 3 Charter Cards to each player; keep 2 and discard 1.
deltas.5: Deal 3 Charter Cards to each player; keep 2 and discard 1.

per_player.name: Starting Quay & Prestige Zero
per_player.static_text: All player counts: Place every Sloop on Central Quay and every Prestige disc on space 0.

stage3_turn.summary: Every turn follows the exact same three-beat rhythm: Sail, take one Harbor Action, then ring the Fog Bell. You may also spend one Harbor Seal once per turn as a free bonus.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Sail Your Sloop (1–2 Channels)
phases.physical_cue: Hold up: Wooden Sloop + 1 Silver coin
phases.say_aloud: Move your Sloop 1 or 2 connected water channels. If you enter an unlit channel with no adjacent Brass Lantern, pay 1 Silver toll into the bank. Lit channels are always free to sail through.
phases.player_summary: Move 1–2 channels. Pay 1 Silver per unlit channel entered (lit channels are free).

phases.name: Phase 2 — Take ONE Harbor Action
phases.physical_cue: Hold up: Brass Lantern, 2 Cargo Crates, then 1 Charter Card
phases.say_aloud: Once docked, pick exactly one of three harbor actions: Light a Lantern, Load Cargo, or Fulfill a Charter.
phases.player_summary: Choose 1 of: Light a Lantern, Load Cargo (max 4 in hold), or Fulfill a Charter.

subactions.name: Light a Lantern
subactions.detail: Pay 1 Timber + 1 Silver to place 1 Brass Lantern on an empty Beacon touching your pier, then claim that Beacon's printed instant bonus.

subactions.name: Load Cargo
subactions.detail: Take up to 2 Crates matching your docked pier icon. Your Sloop hold caps strictly at 4 Crates — swap immediately with the Warehouse if full.

subactions.name: Fulfill a Charter
subactions.detail: Return the required Cargo Crates shown on a private Charter or face-up Wharf Market Charter. Gain its Prestige (★) and 1 Harbor Seal.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Ring the Fog Bell
phases.physical_cue: Hold up: Top Fog Bell card + Fog Bank Buoy
phases.say_aloud: Flip the top Fog Bell card, move the Fog Bank Buoy 1 channel clockwise if shown, refill any empty Wharf Market slots, and pass the turn.
phases.player_summary: Flip top Fog Bell card, drift Fog Bank Buoy if prompted, refill Wharf Market, pass turn.

free_action.name: Free Bonus Action (Once Per Turn)
free_action.detail: Discard 1 Harbor Seal before or after your Phase 2 action to sail +1 extra channel OR swap 1 Cargo Crate in your hold at Central Quay.

stage4_first_round.title: Open-Handed Demo Turn (Seat 1)
stage4_first_round.physical_cue: Move Seat 1 Sloop to Timber Pier
stage4_first_round.say_aloud: Watch me take Turn 1 out loud: I pay 1 Silver to sail into this unlit Timber Pier, then take Load Cargo to put 2 Timber into my Sloop hold.

stage4_first_round.title: Show How Lighting Pays Back
stage4_first_round.physical_cue: Point to Seat 2 Silver + Beacon socket
stage4_first_round.say_aloud: Next turn, anyone sailing near a Timber Beacon can spend 1 Timber + 1 Silver to light a Lantern — making that lane toll-free for everyone and scoring ring bonuses.

stage4_first_round.title: Check Hold Limits Early
stage4_first_round.physical_cue: Tap the 4 cargo slots on a Warden Mat
stage4_first_round.say_aloud: Notice your Sloop only has four crate slots. Under the living errata, you can never stack a fifth crate temporarily — swap straight back to the Warehouse if full.

stage4_first_round.title: Narrate Round 1 Fog Bell Together
stage4_first_round.physical_cue: Flip the first Fog Bell card face up
stage4_first_round.say_aloud: At the end of Seat 1's turn we flip one Fog Bell card. Once everyone finishes Round 1 open-handed, play continues normally at table pace.

top_gotchas.title: 4-Crate Hold Cap Is Immediate (Errata)
top_gotchas.detail: Never exceed 4 Cargo Crates even mid-action; swap directly with the Warehouse when loading a full Sloop.

top_gotchas.title: Fog Toll Applies When Sharing a Pier
top_gotchas.detail: Another captain's Sloop does not light a channel — only a Brass Lantern on an adjacent Beacon waives the 1 Silver fog toll.

top_gotchas.title: Winter Gale Guarantees Equal Turns
top_gotchas.detail: When Winter Gale is revealed (or the final Charter count is met), finish the active round so every seat takes the same number of turns.

edge_cases.title: Warehouse Crate Shortage
edge_cases.detail: Cargo Crates are strictly component-limited. If a pier's color runs empty in the Warehouse, you load only what remains.

edge_cases.title: Harbor Seal Timing Window
edge_cases.detail: You may spend your 1/turn Harbor Seal either before Phase 2 or immediately after Phase 2, never while mid-movement inside Phase 1.

edge_cases.title: Passing Through Occupied Sloops
edge_cases.detail: Sloops never block movement or docking; multiple Sloops may share the same Quay or Pier without penalty.

edge_cases.title: Stranded at an Unlit Reef on Final Turn
edge_cases.detail: If your Sloop ends the game docked at an unlit pier touched by the Fog Bank Buoy, subtract 2 ★ during End-Game Scoring.

errata_list.title: Winter Gale Placement in Fog Bell Deck
errata_list.printed: Printed (p. 4): "Shuffle Winter Gale randomly into the bottom 3 cards of the Fog Bell Deck."
errata_list.corrected: Corrected (Errata v1.2): "Place Winter Gale strictly as the very bottom card of the Fog Bell Deck, unshuffled."

errata_list.title: Cargo Hold Overflow Timing
errata_list.printed: Printed (p. 9): "If you hold more than 4 Crates, discard excess crates down to 4 at the end of your turn."
errata_list.corrected: Corrected (Errata v1.2 / FAQ): "Your Sloop hold can never exceed 4 Crates even mid-action; swap immediately with the Warehouse if full."

verify_before_table.title: 5P Auxiliary Pier Channel Line Discrepancy
verify_before_table.detail: The Setup diagram on p. 4 draws one dashed channel linking the 5P Auxiliary Pier only to East Quay, whereas p. 8 movement rules refer to "both outer channels" of the Auxiliary Pier. Inspect the physical cardboard tile overlay in the box before teaching a 5-player game.

entries: Teaching note (2026-11-18): Mention the 1 Silver fog toll and the 4-crate swap errata while handing out Sloops so nobody hits a surprise on Turn 2.
Table house ruling until Tideglass clarifies 5P: treat only the single printed dashed channel to East Quay as legal.
